title: UEFA and its national associations will not participate in FIFA competitions
summary: UEFA and its 55 national associations issued a joint statement announcing they will not participate in FIFA competitions, representing a significant governance dispute between European football's governing body and FIFA. The statement reflects growing tensions over governance issues, competition control, and financial distribution between the organizations.
problem_solved: This is not a technical or AI-related article; it addresses sports governance disputes rather than technology solutions.
